term: well-founded grounding on one complete actual ancestry cone
definition: The selected grounds relation restricted to the subtype of all actual concrete ancestors of selected is well-founded. Unrelated actual grounding, non-concrete or absent candidates and other worlds are unconstrained. This is a local foundation premise, not a bound on total graph size or a finite observational report.
note: General selected-being form of the existing thinker-local vocabulary, reusing Profile, ActualConcreteGround and Mathlib ReflTransGen unchanged. Source-free application hypotheses remain OPEN. See the selected-cone scope section of docs/notes/ultimate-adequacy-integration-735.md.
